desc:
Etsy order management and shipping support keeps every sale moving from payment to delivery. Ecom Swift LLC works through your open orders, buys labels in your account, uploads tracking and writes to buyers when a delay appears.

## What is Etsy order management?

Etsy order management is everything that happens between a buyer paying and a parcel arriving: confirming order details, preparing labels, shipping, uploading tracking and answering delivery questions. For a busy shop this is a daily job, and falling behind on it harms shop standing and buyer trust.

Ecom Swift LLC runs a fixed sprint on your orders. We handle the current backlog, then write a simple routine so new orders follow the same steps.

## Why orders slip, and what it costs

Orders slip when many things happen at once: a custom item needs one more detail, a label has not been bought, tracking was never uploaded, a buyer asks where the parcel is. None of this is hard, but it is easy to lose track of during a rush or after a trip away from your desk.

The cost shows up in several places. Late shipments can hurt your shop's standing on Etsy. Missing tracking can leave you exposed if a parcel is disputed. Silent delays lead to cases and unhappy reviews, which affect future sales.

## How good order handling protects your results

Order handling does not create demand, but it protects every sale you have already earned. Orders that ship on time with tracking attached lead to fewer questions, fewer cases and better reviews. Better reviews and a healthy shop record support the listings you work hard to promote.

A clear routine also saves your time. When you know exactly what to do for a new order, a gift order, a custom item or a delayed parcel, you stop deciding each case from scratch. This is especially useful before a holiday, when volume jumps and mistakes become costly.

## What good order management includes

- A check of every open order against its ship-by date.
- Confirmation of addresses, personalization notes and gift messages.
- Shipping labels bought through your own Etsy account.
- Tracking numbers uploaded and verified for each order.
- Messages to buyers when a delay or a problem appears.
- Flags on orders at risk of shipping late.
- Steps for returns, cases and not-received claims, written in plain language.
- A checklist for gift and custom orders.
- Saved reply templates and a guide for a helper.

## What we do

We begin with your open orders and sort them by urgency. For each one we confirm the details and the shipping method. In packages that include processing, we buy labels in your account, upload tracking and send the buyer a short update where needed.

We follow Etsy's rules for missing parcels, returns and cases, and any decision about money or an open case comes to you first. Along the way we write your order routine, so you or a helper can continue afterward. The Basic package reviews open orders and writes the routine. Standard processes more orders and handles delay messages. Premium adds a full order desk, reply templates and a hand-off guide. This is a fixed sprint, and daily handling is quoted separately.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Ship in order of the ship-by date, not the order date.
- Upload tracking as soon as a label is bought.
- Tell buyers early when a delay is likely.
- Keep a note of every special request on an order.
- Photograph packages of fragile items before sending.

**Avoid:**
- Marking an order as shipped before it leaves your hands.
- Letting a not-received message wait for days.
- Promising a delivery date the carrier controls.
- Moving a conversation about a problem off Etsy.
- Guessing weight and size when buying a label.

## Who this service is for

It suits a seller facing a holiday backlog and needing extra hands. It fits an owner returning from illness or travel with orders waiting, and a growing shop that has outgrown its own spreadsheet and wants a clear routine before taking on an assistant.

## What we need from you

Share your shipping rules, packaging sizes and any carriers you use, plus a short list of items that need special care. We join your shop as a manager with limited permissions where Etsy supports it. We never need passwords, and you keep full control of money and refunds.
